comment: invent.c display_pickinv() passes PICK_ANY to select_menu() for #wizidentify even when count_unidentified() is 0 and the menu holds only two add_menu_str() lines, so wintty.c process_menu_window()'s MENU_SEARCH arm opens tty_getlin("Search for:") instead of ringing the PICK_NONE bell. Covers an answered search with no selectable entry, an escaped one, an empty one, the bulk keys, and a count stopped by Escape before Escape cancels the menu.
